standard_prerequisites.use: Gives the pseudo-coherence half of perfectness.

core_obligations: By the algebra lemma, the regularity and finite dimensionality of A give finite global dimension (proof lines 21841-21843). The finite-gl-dim-tor-dimension lemma then says every A-module, in particular B, has finite tor dimension (proof lines 21844-21846). Since A is Noetherian and A -> B is of finite type, the Noetherian-pseudo-coherent-ring-map lemma gives that the map is pseudo-coherent; pseudo-coherence plus the finite tor dimension of B is the definition of a perfect ring map (proof lines 21847-21848).
proof_roadmap: Get finite global dimension of A from regularity (proof lines 21841-21843).
Conclude finite tor dimension of B and pseudo-coherence of the map (proof lines 21844-21848).
